reviews.review: Hands down prefer it to its other counterparts and rivals, Fun 90s version of "modern space" with likable cast and pretty good weapons, with weekly modes and a growing workshop support!

I like this game. For this price in low stodio is great. Only weapons are a lil bit bad but alla other is good. 
8/10

I really don't understand how this managed to get 70% positive reviews

Never plan to play in another language that isn't english. French for example, uses some garbage machine translation tool, buttons and options do not make sense so I immediately switched to english

The game looks like any basic amateur Unreal Engine project. The only thing it has for itself visually is the setting. 60's sci-fi is pretty neat, but this game doesn't make the aesthetic any favor.

There's absolutely 0 game feel, and that might be the 2nd worst thing about the game (the very worst thing is coming next). Water guns would feel more effective than whatever the game gives you. There aren't even particles when you shoot zombies, not even blood stains, they just start some dying animation or transform into a ragdoll and that's it, sometimes you don't even know when you've killed them, sometimes you get guns that seem to shoot fire shrapnels (I'm not even sure) that just suddenly despawn 

The worst thing is the fact that the characters are very apparently using AI for their voices. This, or they're just Fiverr guys hired with very poor direction.
If it was just bad or mid voice acting, I'd be totally fine with that and gunfeel would have been the absolute worst thing, but characters talk as if they were playing another game.
A charger spawns ? They just say « Charger ! » with 0 intonation, 0 urgency in the voice, and they say the same thing all 3 at the time, reinforcing the sentiment that they are nothing but mindless bots (the AI is pretty bad too)

Idk how one could play Left 4 Dead and not immediately notice the difference. Back 4 Blood is a masterpiece next to that, granted it doesn't have the same budget so I'm not expecting this to have some groundbreaking AAA features.

But game feel and some form of voice acting should have been the bare minimum, there are cheap games that manage to do that properly, which is why I think the devs just didn't care enough about working on these aspects, maybe they didn't care enough about the game, idk.
At least they wrapped 1.0 ... but it genuinely feels like what I played in playtest/beta or whatever thing I played before its release a few years back. I guess they added "content" in the form of maps or campaign ... but why would I go through that if the moment to moment gameplay doesn't feel like anything at all ?
Pretty neat game, allows easy modding and has a cool community on their discord.
yeah... its not good. honestly buy L4D2 instead.
